description: AE-8/AP-8 RADBELT interpolates trapped-electron and proton flux maps for selected energies and magnetic coordinates. The package includes solar-minimum and solar-maximum environments and an interactive driver. The resource is documented by NASA Community Coordinated Modeling Center (metadata publisher; developer not specified). The documented physical domain is Magnetosphere / Global Magnetosphere; grid spacing, supported periods and cadence depend on this version and its chosen configuration. The documentation links Instant Run. A software licence and any external distribution charge are not stated. These are empirical reference environments, not forecasts of an individual radiation-belt event. The documented space-weather effects make it a potential environmental input for infrastructure hazard exposure and resilience simulations. It is related to platform-nasa-ccmc in this catalogue. Only metadata were checked; numerical accuracy and current service availability remain unverified.
